purpose: Inspect continuity-bounded rainflow reconstruction from the selected vehicle's returned drive and charging SoC endpoints, including sensitivity, source support, exclusions and interpretation limits.
primaryGoal: Understand observed cycle ranges and the limits of independently capped source histories without interpreting illustrative stress as battery damage, health, warranty status or remaining life.

dataSources.behavior: Independent history key includes ID and bounded limit; vehicle-gated; forwards AbortSignal; MODERATE staleTime; safeArray select; no date bounds or pagination loop.
dataSources.limits: Registration verified from source, not an HTTP response. Backend ordering, exact cap enforcement and returned payload correctness not exercised.

dataSources.behavior: Separate history cache key; bounds limit to 1-1000; forwards AbortSignal; vehicle-gated; MODERATE staleTime; safeArray select.
dataSources.limits: Hook contract is an observed single-page window, not a full-history claim. Handler/repository behavior not independently audited.

dataSources.owner: Existing workspace selection and timezone owners
dataSources.behavior: Shared selection resolves URL, persisted selection and first fleet vehicle; no duplicate local vehicle selector. workspaceScope.ts:23-77,98-131,165-176 gives /cycle-stress vehicle=true, range=false. This page explicitly analyzes returned history rather than a selected date window.
dataSources.limits: Vehicle hook inspected; nested fleet/settings/timezone requests and shell/mobile selection not exercised. Do not add range ownership without changing both source hooks and preserving current bounded-history semantics.

dataSources.owner: Battery-domain pure model and presentation trust adapter
dataSources.behavior: Memoized model uses returned rows, vehicle timezone, frozen mount clock, selectable depth threshold/exponent and 1000-row limit. Trust adapter preserves independently available histories and per-source errors/offline state.
dataSources.limits: Inspected eligibility and final result assembly, not every intermediate calculation; no algorithm tests executed. Drive inputs use existing startTs/endTs/startBatteryPct/endBatteryPct; charging inputs use explicit ended_at and start/end_soc_pct.

components.name: PageLayout / Section / Grid
components.usage: Root orchestrator; three named paired-chart sections; single column until allocated container reaches 1024px. No root loading/error gate.
components.contract: Preserve root title/subtitle, section IDs, min-w-0, full width and container-based paired chart layout. Shared implementation was not audited.

components.name: CycleStressSummary / BatteryEvidenceBrief / OperationalBrief
components.usage: Six numeric specialist metrics, bounded-period provenance and shared details drawer. Stable control IDs cycle-stress-threshold and cycle-stress-exponent.
components.contract: Summary result/trust/locale/deepThresholdPct/exponent/change callbacks; brief metrics/period/loading/retained/context. Preserve numeric inputs and fractional cycles.

components.name: ChartContainer / chart category renderers
components.usage: Seven chart shells with accessible names, dataColumns and exportData; retain chart series, interactive legend and raw derived rows.
components.contract: title/subtitle/ariaLabel/height/loading/exportable/exportData/data/dataColumns; chartKey/hiddenSeries where currently supplied. Shared chart internals not inspected.

components.name: DataTable / MobileDataTableAdapter
components.usage: Directory and accounting use real processed-row mobile adapters; directory hidden card roles do NOT remove fields from Quick view. Accounting uses keyValue mode.
components.contract: Preserve tableIds battery:cycle-stress-directory and battery:cycle-stress-accounting, ordering, keys, value filters, exports and full-detail fields. Adapter modal iterates allColumns; mobile detail access is source-supported, not runtime accepted.

components.name: CycleStressSectionBody / CycleStressSourceStatus
components.usage: Localized no-vehicle/loading/error/pending/empty/no-qualified/no-cycle interiors; requirements none/intervals/cycles/turningPoints; per-source recovery.
components.contract: Keep source-independent shells and methodology mounted; refresh errors must not discard retained data.

components.name: MetricCard / GlassPanel / Text / Heading / PanelTitle / Select / Button / AlertBanner / FadeIn
components.usage: Domain diagnostic cards, methodology, accessible shared controls and entrance transitions. FadeIn already honors reduced motion.
components.contract: Reuse existing primitives; no competing card, status registry, formatter, table controller or motion system.

duplicatedPatterns.fix: During an authorized implementation, reconcile consumers before retiring duplicates; retain original capabilities and stable IDs. Do not delete based solely on this bounded audit.

issues.detail: Coverage MetricCards supply important source-span and cap explanations but omit wrapLabel/compact. Shared MetricCard.tsx:90-96 truncates labels by default and :115-116 always truncates noncompact subtitles. Long ranges and source cap-status text can be clipped without a caller-provided reveal path. Continuity, composition and support reuse the same pattern.
issues.fix: Reuse existing compact/wrapping metric presentation and keep complete source captions visible; verify long localized labels and source spans. Shared subtitle wrapping may require an owner change; do not shorten/delete evidence.

responsive.verification: Every prescribed viewport, allocated container width, mobile detail modal, long translation, RTL and 200%-text behavior unverified.

accessibility.verification: Keyboard, focus restoration, chart/table interaction, screen reader, effective contrast, forced colors, touch targets and OS reduced-motion behavior unverified; ARIA/source tokens do not prove acceptance.

states.loading: Queries enabled only for a selected vehicle. No available source gives initial loading; one resolved history can render while the other remains pending. All section shells and methodology survive.
states.empty: Resolved empty arrays remain known returned zero; no accepted interval and no countable cycles have distinct explanations; missing SoC is classified out, not imputed.
states.error: Fatal error only when neither source is available and both settle. Independent failures get per-source retry; retained data survives refresh error.
states.partial: Model uses available evidence; failed/loading source names are surfaced. Coverage renders unavailable source values as em dash.
states.offline: Summary marks retained evidence when a source has data and isRefreshBlocked. SourceStatus announces paused sources and offers independent retry.

issues.detail: Accounting brief sets retained only from state.refreshError. The summary checks per-source isRefreshBlocked as well (Summary:124-126), but queryState.ts:32-34 does not turn offline pause into refreshError. Cached accounting can therefore say Available source readings while the summary correctly says Retained source evidence.
issues.fix: Pass the same per-source trust-derived retained/offline presentation into accounting without changing rows, counts, keys or request policy.

issues.detail: When any source is affected, the component replaces rather than composes CycleStressQueryStatus. Cap/qualification/thin-support summary notices in QueryStatus.tsx:149-218 are then not emitted here. Coverage and methodology retain cap disclosures elsewhere, so this is loss of co-located trust context, not complete page loss.
issues.fix: Compose independent source recovery and applicable bounded-evidence notices rather than treating them as exclusive. Deduplicate refresh warnings while retaining cap, qualification and support explanations beside summary readings.

visualIssues.detail: Support assigns purple/cyan/green/blue/amber/red to ordinary diagnostic cards; Coverage:118-309, Continuity:76-233 and Composition:82-160 repeat multi-hue assignments. Fixed text-cyan-300 section icons and amber directory values bypass theme-adaptive semantic hierarchy. Shared MetricCard neutralizes surfaces/text but still applies color-map icon text; actual palette/contrast remains unmeasured.
visualIssues.fix: Use neutral token-driven section icons and diagnostic emphasis; reserve subdued semantic color for actual warnings, boundaries or meaningful series. Preserve user-selected chart palettes and source distinctions rather than changing persistence or globally resetting colors.

priority.reason: Existing source decomposition and independent trust handling are strong. Align accounting offline trust, preserve co-located caveats, remove diagnostic rainbow emphasis and expose full metric captions before runtime acceptance.

dataBehavior: Separate capped drive and charging histories; no selected-date-range/lifetime equivalence claim.
Frozen mount clock; vehicle-local month/day/week calendar; explicit completion timestamps only.
Reject missing/invalid/future/direction-inconsistent SoC intervals; account every returned row; no missing SoC imputation.
Preserve conservative overlap/gap/jump segmentation, full and boundary-half cycle weights, EFC and illustrative exponent calculations.
Keep all raw result fields, chart export rows, capped recent cycles/timeline and omitted-count metadata.
Duration remains seconds in model; directory uses existing formatter with milliseconds conversion only at display boundary. SoC/depth/index/counts retain dimensionless semantics.
Retain all non-claims: no battery health, damage, degradation, safety, warranty, remaining-life or charging-prescription inference.
Do not replace unknown/unavailable source values with fabricated measured zeros; retain independent successful and cached histories.
